text:
## Abstract  
We queried the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) to identify the sequencing platform and organism associated with Series accession GSE309890. Using the geo_series tool, which wraps an Entrez `esummary` request and supplements it with FTP parsing, we retrieved one Series record. The record reports a single platform, GPL24659, and designates Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 as the studied organism. No PubMed entry is yet linked to this dataset. These findings resolve the minimal metadata required for downstream use of the processed expression matrix and for selecting compatible downstream analysis resources.

## I. Introduction  
Background. GEO Series GSE309890 examines antibiotic-resistance evolution in Escherichia coli under sertraline exposure.  
Literature Review. No literature was retrieved for this query.  
Knowledge Gap. The user needed confirmation of the experimental platform and the exact organism before reusing the data.  
Objective & Hypothesis. Objective: determine the platform and organism for GSE309890. Hypothesis: the Series metadata contains a single platform and clearly states the organism.

## II. Materials and Methods  
Study Design. A direct Series-level query was sufficient; no additional database cross-links were required.  
Materials. GEO via Entrez (`geo_series` tool).  
Procedures.  
1. geo_series(accession = "GSE309890", list_files = true).  
   • Internally resolved GSE309890 → UID 200309890.  
   • Called esummary.fcgi with db = gds & id = 200309890.  
   • Parsed returned JSON and FTP directory for supplementary files.  
Statistical Analysis. The response was inspected for the fields `platform` (string) and `taxon` (string). Counts: platforms = 1, organisms = 1.

## III. Results  
Data Presentation.  
Table 1. Key metadata extracted from GEO Series GSE309890  

| GEO Accession | Platform (GPL) | Organism (Taxon) | Sample Count |
|---------------|----------------|------------------|--------------|
| GSE309890     | GPL24659       | Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 | 6 |

Findings. The Series was generated on platform GPL24659 and involves samples from Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655. Six samples are included.

## IV. Discussion  
Interpretation. The retrieved metadata confirm the study’s reliance on a single platform (GPL24659) and its focus on a well-characterized laboratory E. coli strain, facilitating replication or meta-analysis.  
Context. The absence of a PubMed link suggests the study may be unpublished or not yet indexed, emphasizing the importance of relying on GEO metadata for experimental details.  
Limitations. GEO metadata accuracy depends on submitter input; misannotation cannot be ruled out without inspecting raw data or associated publications.  
Conclusion & Future Directions. GSE309890 employs platform GPL24659 and focuses on E. coli K-12 MG1655. Future work could retrieve and re-analyse the supplied FPKM matrix or integrate these data with other E. coli transcriptomic studies using the same platform.

## References  
[1] GEO Series record for GSE309890. NCBI GEO. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890  
[2] Entrez esummary call (geo_series tool provenance). https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gds&id=200309890&version=2.0  

## Acknowledgments  
We thank the NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus team for maintaining public access to gene-expression datasets and associated metadata.
